subject.title: [Feature]: Plugin API for aborting agent runs (api.runtime.agent.abort)

question: Should OpenClaw expose a plugin runtime abort method by run id, or should plugins use the existing Gateway/SDK cancellation boundary instead?
rationale: The API gap is real, but the permanent contract decides whether plugin code may terminate agent runs and what ownership, session, and permission checks gate that authority.

options.title: Approve scoped runtime abort
options.body: Add `api.runtime.agent.abort` only with explicit run ownership/session scoping, permission documentation, API baseline updates, and regression tests.

options.title: Use Gateway/SDK cancellation only
options.body: Reject the injected runtime method and document `sessions.abort`, `Run.cancel()`, or a narrower SDK cancel path as the supported cancellation contract.

options.title: Wait for session-run-cancel direction
options.body: Defer this issue until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/75371 lands or closes, then reassess whether a separate agent runtime method remains necessary.

recommendation.title: Approve scoped runtime abort
recommendation.body: Add `api.runtime.agent.abort` only with explicit run ownership/session scoping, permission documentation, API baseline updates, and regression tests.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest current-source and related-thread history on the plugin runtime and Gateway cancellation surfaces involved in the authority decision.
